test_records.MQL: db.books.aggregate([ { $group: { _id: "$condition", p50: { $percentile: { input: "$pages", p: [0.5], method: "approximate" } }, p95: { $percentile: { input: "$pages", p: [0.95], method: "approximate" } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, condition: "$_id", p50: 1, p95: 1 } }])

known_variants: db.books.aggregate([ { $group: { _id: "$condition", p50: { $percentile: { input: "$pages", p: [0.5], method: "approximate" } }, p95: { $percentile: { input: "$pages", p: [0.95], method: "approximate" } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, condition: "$_id", p50: 1, p95: 1 } }])

nl_queries: 把 title 按阈值分成高低两组，并分别按 condition 汇总。
做一个高低分面的统计视图。
按阈值拆成两个分支再统计类别分布。
用 facet 输出高值和低值的双视图。
Split into high and low facets by title.
test_records.MQL: db.books.aggregate([ { $facet: { high: [{ $match: { "title": { $gt: 70 } } }, { $group: { _id: "$condition", count: { $sum: 1 } } }], low: [{ $match: { "title": { $lte: 70 } } }, { $group: { _id: "$condition", count: { $sum: 1 } } }] } }, { $project: { _id: 0, high: 1, low: 1 } }])

known_variants: db.books.aggregate([ { $facet: { high: [{ $match: { "title": { $gt: 70 } } }, { $group: { _id: "$condition", count: { $sum: 1 } } }], low: [{ $match: { "title": { $lte: 70 } } }, { $group: { _id: "$condition", count: { $sum: 1 } } }] } }, { $project: { _id: 0, high: 1, low: 1 } }])
